src: 8-connected objects away from the full-height side wall of the same color
path: horizontal slide toward the matching side wall, stopping just before the wall or an already settled same-color object would overlap
trajectory: translate each object rigidly to its final unobstructed position
transform: clear original object positions, keep both side walls fixed, and preserve each moved object's color and shape
multi_step: For each wall color, settle objects from nearest to farthest from that wall so later objects can stop against earlier same-color objects.
